name: typer
title: Typer
description: Types pasted text into the focused field as real keystrokes. Press Escape to cancel.
author: brahimhamichan

commands.name: type-text
commands.title: Typer
commands.subtitle: Type text as keystrokes
commands.description: Paste text, press Enter, and it is typed into the previously focused field.

scripts.build:helper: swiftc -O helper/typer.swift -o /tmp/typer-arm -target arm64-apple-macos12 && swiftc -O helper/typer.swift -o /tmp/typer-x86 -target x86_64-apple-macos12 && lipo -create /tmp/typer-arm /tmp/typer-x86 -output assets/typer-helper
